532:t_1:89.en:
$$クルツ$$
「No matter what anyone says, I'm doing it! A chance like this barely ever comes along!」

532:t_1:90.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Come on, Al! While Sousuke's away...」

532:t_1:91.en:
$n
「$$クルツ$$... You'll have to beat me first.」

532:t_1:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「There it is. The $$ハンター$$ smile, first time in ages.」

532:t_1:93.en:
$$クルツ$$
「W-what, $n!? You gonna get in my way?」

532:t_1:94.en:
$n
「I'm not going to allow anything $$千鳥$$ would hate right in front of me.」

532:t_1:96.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
($$宗介$$, $$かなめ$$ and $n in a love triangle...!?)

532:t_1:97.en:
$$クラン$$
(This is no time to be happy about it! That's improper, $$ミレーヌ$$!)

532:t_1:98.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Besides, it looks like the match is already decided.)

532:t_1:99.en:
$$ランカ$$
($n... Does he still like $$かなめ$$ after all...?)

532:t_1:100.en:
$n
「...So what'll it be, $$クルツ$$? Let's do it like men, with our bare hands.」

532:t_1:101.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Who'd brawl bare-handed with you!? A ladies' man has no money and no muscle!」

532:t_1:102.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Heh... No money, huh? You're getting closer and closer to me, $$クルツ$$.」

532:t_1:103.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't casually treat me like one of your pals!」

532:t_1:104.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Still, you're an odd one, $n. Protecting $$宗介$$ when there's not a cent in it for you.」

532:t_1:105.en:
$n
「That's what the volunteer spirit is all about.」

532:t_1:106.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...Is that really all it is?」

532:t_1:108.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Everyone's talking. They say the one $n really likes is that girl $$かなめ$$.」

532:t_1:111.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(He's dead serious, like super-duper serious!)

532:t_1:113.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So you do like her?」

532:t_1:116.en:
$$ランカ$$
(Um... so $n likes $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$, and $$宗介$$ likes $$かなめ$$, and $$かなめ$$ likes $$宗介$$...)

532:t_1:117.en:
$$シェリル$$
(Is that called a love triangle too...?)

532:t_1:118.en:
$n
「$$千鳥$$ was kind to me when I'd just transferred, and $$宗介$$ was the first friend I made at school...」

532:t_1:119.en:
$n
「So I really want the two of them to be happy. I like seeing them together.」

532:t_1:120.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So that's what you meant.」

532:t_1:122.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Anyway, the whole gallery seems relieved.」

532:t_1:124.en:
$$クラン$$
「Of course. You have Miss $$スズネ$$, after all.」

532:t_1:125.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'll cheer you on too! $$宗介$$ and $$かなめ$$... and $n!」

532:t_1:128.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Someone falling for someone... It'd be sad if somebody got hurt because of it, after all.」

532:t_1:129.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$ seems to have settled down lately, too.」

532:t_1:132.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Human hearts are fragile. Some small trigger could leave her unstable again, like before.」

532:t_1:134.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What's this, Leading Lady? Looks like nothing progressed while I was away.」

532:t_1:136.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... don't push yourself. Paying off debts and romance both come down to building up a little at a time.」

532:t_1:137.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Rushing to an answer probably wouldn't turn out well anyway.」

532:t_1:139.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...I hear we're heading to $$新日本$$ on $$ゼロ$$'s orders. Are we going to liberate that area from the Empire?」

532:t_1:140.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That doesn't seem to be his aim.」

532:t_1:142.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I heard from $$スザク$$ that our destination is $$神根島$$.」

532:t_1:144.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah, that's right. It's where $$ゼロ$$ settled things with $$シャルル・ジ・ブリタニア$$.」

532:t_2:6.en:
$$カレン$$
(Right in front of this door, $$スザク$$ and $$ルルーシュ$$ aimed guns at each other...)

532:t_2:7.en:
$$カレン$$
(Come to think of it, this is where $$ルルーシュ$$'s real fight began...)

532:t_2:8.en:
$$桂$$
「Reminiscing is fine and all, $$ゼロ$$... but how about telling us why you brought the $c members here?」

532:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The people here will help me with my experiment.」

532:t_2:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Ideally, I wanted the members in space and in Japan to take part as well.」

532:t_2:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why wasn't there any explanation until now?」

532:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I wanted to eliminate unnecessary preconceptions and have you behave naturally.」

532:t_2:14.en:
$$オルソン$$
「Using the $c members... Does this have something to do with the $$烙印$$?」

532:t_2:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「As expected of a $$特異点$$, $$オルソン・Ｄ・ヴェルヌ$$... You catch on quickly.」

532:t_2:16.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm the other $$特異点$$, and I don't have a clue about any of that.」

532:t_2:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$オルソン$$ was held captive by the $$サイデリアル$$... He must have something on his mind.)

532:t_2:18.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$烙印$$... The mark carved into those whose fate is to be tossed about by the $$時空震動$$...」

532:t_2:19.en:
$$マオ$$
「But that's about the old $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ members, right?」

532:t_2:20.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Seems to me the $$ミスリル$$ crew, $$レド$$, $$テイタニア$$ and the rest have nothing to do with it.」

532:t_2:22.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「We can't afford to think that way.」

532:t_2:24.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Given the jump to the center of the galaxy, we can consider the $$烙印$$ already carved into $c and all its collaborators.」

532:t_2:26.en:
$$レド$$
「Are we going to have our fates tossed about by the $$時空震動$$ too...?」
